# Code of Conduct

[Русский](../doc/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.rus.md)

## Our standards

Project discussions should stay practical, respectful, and focused on improving the documentation and site.

Examples of expected behavior:

- explain technical disagreements with concrete arguments;
- give feedback on the work, not on the person;
- respect maintainers' decisions about scope and priorities;
- avoid insults, harassment, spam, and off-topic arguments.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may edit, hide, or remove comments and contributions that violate these standards. Repeated or severe violations may lead to temporary or permanent restrictions from project spaces.

If you need to report a conduct issue, contact the maintainers through a private channel when available, or open a GitHub report using the platform tools.
